stemMd: Suppose the additional condition is: Alignment must be in position 1. Which further statement must then be true?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Alignment and Balance must not occupy consecutive positions.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Alignment must not be in position 1.

explanationMd:
First restrict attention to orders satisfying the extra condition as well as the original rules. There are 1 such orders. "Alignment and Balance must not occupy consecutive positions." holds throughout this restricted set; the other statements fail on the explicit examples in their feedback.

The remaining orders are:
- Alignment → Cooling → Electrical → Drive → Balance

distractorRationale.b: Even with the additional condition, Alignment → Cooling → Electrical → Drive → Balance is permitted and makes this statement false.
